subject: 970 Fellsway 40B Development Design Refinement
overview: The Board reviewed a revised 'preferred alternative' conceptual site plan for the 289-unit residential project at 970 Fellsway, featuring building height reductions and increased public green space. The Board directed the applicant to proceed with detailed architectural and engineering designs based on this updated concept.

items.title: 970 Fellsway Comprehensive Permit (Case 40B-2023-01)
items.summary: The applicant presented a revised site plan incorporating five-story step-downs near residential neighbors, increased setbacks along Amaranth Avenue, and internal relocation of surface parking to improve the public realm. The Board directed the developer to advance to detailed design and continued the public hearing to February 27 to review traffic and engineering studies.

items.title: Administrative Updates and Minutes
items.summary: No administrative updates were provided, and the approval of meeting minutes was deferred to a later session.
